bio: Zheng Wang is an Associated Professor specializing in medical imaging analysis, disease identification, bioinformatics, and the development of computational models for multimodal data fusion in the medical field.

He holds a Doctor's degree in Computational Mathematics and a Master's degree in Informatics (Diplom-Informatiker). His research focuses on applying deep learning and artificial intelligence to clinical decision support, particularly in dermatology, radiology and gastroenterology.

bio: Zheng Wang 是一位副教授，专业领域包括医学影像分析、疾病识别、生物信息学以及医学领域多模态数据融合计算模型的开发。
他拥有计算数学博士学位和信息学硕士学位。他的研究重点是将深度学习和人工智能应用于临床决策支持，特别是皮肤科、放射科和胃肠病学领域。

featuredProjects.title: Portable Rechargeable Multi-function Handheld Console based on LiChuang SkyStar
featuredProjects.venue: Second Prize, Jialichuang Electronic Design Competition (2024)
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: Designed a portable multi-function handheld console based on LiChuang SkyStar GD32F407VET6. Features include charging management, clock/alarm display, electronic piano, games (Snake, Dino Run), and background 1-bit music playback. Implemented object-oriented programming in C, multi-level menu UI, and dynamic key scanning (long press, double click, etc.).

featuredProjects.title: Smart Integrated Seeder based on Satellite Positioning Technology
featuredProjects.venue: First Prize, 5th Hunan College Student Intelligent Navigation Technology Innovation Competition (2023)
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: Integrated satellite positioning technology into a smart seeder. Developed Web and mobile interfaces using Alibaba Cloud IoT Studio. Implemented image transmission via ESP32 and data communication via ESP8266/Bluetooth. Designed motor driver and power PCB. Performed NMEA0183 protocol parsing, MPU9250 DMP attitude calculation, and PID algorithms for Beidou positioning and obstacle avoidance navigation.

featuredProjects.title: Smart Integrated Seeder based on Mobile Remote Control
featuredProjects.venue: Second Prize, 2023 RAICOM National Finals; Provincial Project, Hunan College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: Responsible for the 3D mechanical structure design, power management, and motor driver PCB design. Implemented Bluetooth control algorithms and ported FreeRTOS to STM32 to coordinate seeder functions, improving efficiency and real-time performance.

featuredProjects.title: IoT Smart Water Dispenser Control System based on ESP32
featuredProjects.venue: Third Prize, Application Track, Central Region, 6th National College Student Embedded Chip and System Design Competition (2023)
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: Developed an IoT smart water dispenser control system using ESP32. Controlled motors and SPI display screens, managed RFID data communication, and stored parameters in W25Q64. Uploaded data to Alibaba Cloud via MQTT and built an IoT monitoring dashboard.

bio: 谭慧文是一名嵌入式软件工程师，拥有湖南第一师范学院电子信息工程学士学位。在ARM单片机开发、RTOS移植以及无线通信协议方面拥有扎实的背景。技术专长包括C/C++编程、Linux开发、
在长沙北斗产业安全技术研究院实习期间，负责4G/433通信协议、FreeRTOS移植及驱动开发工作。曾成功领导多个获奖项目，涉及物联网系统、智能农业机械及便携式消费电子产品。

featuredProjects.title: 基于立创天空星的便携式可充电多功能掌机
featuredProjects.venue: Second Prize, Jialichuang Electronic Design Competition (2024)
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: 基于立创天空星GD32F407VET6设计了一款便携式多功能掌机。功能包括充电管理（查看电量、充电动画等）、时间/闹钟/日期的显示与设置、电子琴、小游戏（《贪吃蛇》、《小恐龙快跑》）以及后台“1bit音乐”播放。使用C语言实现了面向对象编程思想，设计了多级菜单UI，并实现了动态按键扫描（长按、双击等）。

featuredProjects.title: 基于卫星定位技术的智能一体化播种机
featuredProjects.venue: First Prize, 5th Hunan College Student Intelligent Navigation Technology Innovation Competition (2023)
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: 将卫星定位技术集成到智能播种机中。利用阿里云IoT Studio开发了Web和移动端界面。通过ESP32实现图传，通过ESP8266和蓝牙模块进行数据通信。设计了电机驱动和电源PCB。进行了NMEA0183协议解析、MPU9250 DMP姿态解算以及PID算法运算，实现了北斗定位和避障导航功能。

featuredProjects.title: 基于移动端远程控制的智能一体化播种机
featuredProjects.venue: Second Prize, 2023 RAICOM National Finals; Provincial Project, Hunan College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: 负责播种机的一体化机械结构3D设计、电源管理以及电机驱动PCB电路设计。实现了蓝牙控制算法，并将FreeRTOS移植到STM32，以协调播种机的各项功能，提高了效率和实时性。

featuredProjects.title: 基于ESP32的物联网智能饮水机控制系统
featuredProjects.venue: Third Prize, Application Track, Central Region, 6th National College Student Embedded Chip and System Design Competition (2023)
featuredProjects.authors: Tan Hui
featuredProjects.summary: 利用ESP32开发了物联网智能饮水机控制系统。控制电机和SPI显示屏，管理RFID数据通信，并使用W25Q64存储设备阈值控制等参数。通过MQTT协议将数据上传至阿里云平台，并搭建了物联网后台监控界面。
